integrity: The general proof uses positive comparison resolvents and exact integrated edge kernels; enumerations are consistency checks only. Earlier interval bound 3 and its sharpness are explicitly treated as prior art, and inaccessible full text in weighted finite element literature leaves an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected loopless graphs, positive edgewise constant densities and real continuous degree-one edgewise-affine projection; the closed exact norm formula is restricted to bipartite graphs; arbitrary higher-order splines, general nonconstant edge densities, and finite nonbipartite exact norms are not treated. The constant 3 is an unattained family supremum.
title: A sharp uniform projector bound and an exact bipartite edge-deficit formula on metric graphs
